metadata.description: Get the list of blog authors.
metadata.learn_more: Get the list of blog authors. Supports paging and filtering. This method would be useful for an integration that examined these models and used an external service to suggest edits.

after.label: After
after.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Specifies whether to return deleted Blog Authors. Defaults to `false`.

createdAfter.label: Created After
createdAfter.description: Only return Blog Authors created after the specified time.

createdAt.label: Created At
createdAt.description: Only return Blog Authors created at exactly the specified time.

createdBefore.label: Created Before
createdBefore.description: Only return Blog Authors created before the specified time.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: The maximum number of results to return. Default is 100.

property.label: Property
property.description: Used to specify which properties of the Blog Authors to include in the response.

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Specifies which fields to use for sorting results. Valid fields are `name`, `created`, `updated`, `createdBy`, `updatedBy`. `created` will be used by default.

updatedAfter.label: Updated After
updatedAfter.description: Only return Blog Authors last updated after the specified time.

updatedAt.label: Updated At
updatedAt.description: Only return Blog Authors last updated at exactly the specified time.

updatedBefore.label: Updated Before
updatedBefore.description: Only return Blog Authors last updated before the specified time.
